Traditional segmentation methods are solely based on attribute data such as demographics (age, sex, ethnicity, education, etc.) and psychographic profiles (lifestyle, personality, motives, etc.). We assume that the bids are small with respect to the daily budgets of the advertisers (i.e, for each i and q, b iq << Bi ) . Moreover, each advertisement slot can be allocated to at most one advertiser and the advertiser is charged his bid from his budget.
